Pokémon & TCG Card Shops in Canada

By Nathan Wiebe, CPA — collector, and a buyer and seller of cards. Published July 28, 2026.

318 shops in the Sports Cards Near Me directory carry Pokémon cards, across 121 Canadian cities, alongside 264 shops carrying Magic: The Gathering. This directory is built around sports cards, but the same local shops overwhelmingly carry other trading card games too.

Does a Sports Card Directory Really Cover Pokémon?

Sports Cards Near Me is built and branded around sports cards, but the shops we list rarely sell only one thing. 318 of the 614 shops in our directory list Pokémon among what they carry — a real majority — because most independent card shops stock whatever their local collectors buy, sports and trading card games alike. This page exists because that overlap is genuinely large, not because we're trying to be something we're not.

How Many Pokémon Card Shops Are in Canada?

Our directory currently tracks 318 shops carrying Pokémon cards across 121 Canadian cities. That's a live count computed from the same shop data behind the rest of the site, so it grows as we verify more shops — it isn't a fixed number we typed in once and forgot about.

Do These Shops Also Carry Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh, or Other TCGs?

Often, yes. Alongside Pokémon, our directory currently tracks 264 shops carrying Magic: The Gathering, 1 carrying Yu-Gi-Oh, 2 carrying Lorcana, and 4 carrying the One Piece card game. A shop that lists one trading card game frequently lists several, since most run the same singles cases and trade nights across all of them.

How Do I Find a Pokémon Shop Near Me?

The list above covers the cities with the most Pokémon-carrying shops, but it isn't the whole country. The Pokémon shop directory lets you browse every city we track, province by province, with each shop's rating, address, and map pin. If you're also after sports cards in the same trip, the full directory shows every category side by side for a given shop.
